summary: Crypto markets show early signs of recovery on July 19 as bulls buy minor dips, with Bitcoin stabilizing above its 50-day SMA and Solana breaking a descending triangle pattern. Sentiment is cautiously bullish for major caps like BTC and SOL, while analysts highlight new opportunities in privacy coins (Zcash, Monero) and AI/narrative tokens (Virtual Protocol, Render, Caspa).
